path.description: File path (`docs`/`adr` scopes) or `session:<id>` (`session` scope, no real file path).

chunk.description: The full content of the retrieved chunk.

score.description: Combined score (vector + lexical), already filtered by the threshold.

excerpt.description: Short preview of the chunk, for display without blowing up the model's context.

degraded.description: `true` when the QUERY embedding was not available and the search fell back to lexical-only (same semantics as `vectorAvailable: false` from `HybridSearchUseCase`).

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.
